pages.text: The pump scans below a marked rectangle for water or lava. Link $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:mining/ender_markers)four Ender Markers$(/l) as for a quarry and place the pump beside the linked corner.$(br2)Right-click to start it. Supply FE and set a tank directly above the pump.
The Ender Quarry recipe consumes two completed pumps.

pages.name: Receiver Placement
pages.text: The receiver must accept fluid from below. Supply FE and attach the corner marker on free faces.

pages.title: Collecting Fluid
pages.text: The first source the pump takes selects water or lava for that run. It skips flowing liquid and waterlogged blocks. Each collected source yields one bucket.$(br2)The pump starts one block below itself and scans down to the world’s minimum build height.

pages.title: Tank and Backfill
pages.text: The pump keeps up to $(thing)64 buckets$() in its internal tank and stops when the next bucket will not fit. It resumes when a receiver accepts fluid.$(br2)A drained source becomes stone. An adjacent $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:mining/quarry_upgrades)World Hole Upgrade$(/l) leaves air instead.

pages.title: Troubleshooting
pages.text: If the scan stalls, check the FE supply and keep the target chunk loaded. Check that the tank above can accept the selected fluid from its underside.$(br2)Right-click the pump to see whether it is active, blocked, or finished.
